description: This Java class represents the response to a 'ModifyAttribute' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details such as the target Thing's ID, the attribute being modified, its new value, and relevant HTTP status information. The class provides methods for creating instances based on command outcomes, parsing JSON representations, and accessing response data.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a 'ModifyAttribute' command, encapsulating attributes like the target Thing's ID, attribute pointer, attribute value, and HTTP status information. Provides factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for response data.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating an attribute was created, with HTTP status 201 (Created). Deprecated version accepts a String ThingId; preferred version accepts a typed ThingId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating an attribute was modified, with HTTP status 204 (No Content). Deprecated version accepts a String ThingId; preferred version accepts a typed ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttributeResponse instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttributeResponse instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the attribute being modified.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the new attribute value, if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity (attribute value) in the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer representing the resource path of the attribute.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into a JSON object builder.
